caption:
does milk cause acne?

A 2018 review pooled 14 studies with 78,529 young people aged 7 to 30. Drinking any milk was linked to about 1.3 times the odds of acne, and one glass a day to about 1.4 times.

These were observational studies, and the authors flagged publication bias, so this shows a link, not proof.

If you break out easily, it may be worth noticing how your skin does with and without it.

Save this before you blame, or keep, the milk.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Source:
Juhl et al., Nutrients 2018. doi:10.3390/nu10081049
